name: chat-smoke-test
title: Edited from the chat, start to finish
what: A 24 s synthetic spoken take (a computer voice over a test pattern) with a retake, a filler and a long pause, driven through the kirocut tools as the Kiro chat calls them: cut to 9 s, reviewed with a note, approved, captioned and zoomed in the default style, a line added at the end, then rendered. The replay shows each step.
